    AgenticAdHocParseListener

    The parking condition: an agentic scope ends through its handler, never on its own.
    AgenticAdHocProcessEnginePlugin
    What an agentic ad hoc sub process needs from the engine: the parse listener that recognises one, the handler that runs a turn, and the retry of a failed turn.
    AgenticAdHocStartListener

    AgenticCaughtError

    AgenticOutcome

    AgenticScopes
    Finding an ad hoc scope from an execution, and reading what the parse listener left on it.
    AgenticToolCatalogParser
    Builds the tool catalogue of an agentic ad hoc sub process at parse time.
    AgenticToolCatalogParser.Parsing
    One parse of a process, as the agent's checks see it (CIB7-2136, CIB7-2367): which process, and whether it is deployed now or only parsed again, from a deployment made earlier, after a restart, a cache eviction or on another node.
    AgenticToolCatalogParser.Reading
    How the engine reads the text of an element (CIB7-2136), as ScriptUtil decides: as an expression; as script code, which no expression reads; as a script in JUEL, which the JUEL script engine evaluates as an expression that knows none of the engine's functions; or as a dynamic script, whose source starts with ${ and is an expression that computes the code.
    AgenticToolEndRecorder

    AgenticToolParameterFunction
    How the catalogue reads the expression function toolParameter (CIB7-2136), with which a tool declares a parameter where it uses it, in an input mapping:
    AgenticToolResultCarrier
    At the end of a tool that holds variables of its own (a scope, or each instance of a multi-instance tool with a mapping or a call activity): carries the declared results it holds there out of it, before its execution and its variables go (CIB7-2215).
    AgenticTurnFailedJobCommandFactory
    Hands a failed turn job to AgenticTurnJobRetryCmd, and every other job to the factory the engine had before (CIB7-2149).
    AgenticTurnJobHandler
    One turn of an agentic ad hoc scope, in its own transaction.
    AgenticTurnJobHandler.Configuration
    Carries the scope execution id, which is also the key the scheduler looks a waiting job up by -- covered by ACT_IDX_JOB_HANDLER.
    AgenticTurnJobRetryCmd
    The engine's retry of a failed job, for a turn job (CIB7-2149): the next attempt waits for the scope's retry cycle instead of following at once.
    AgenticTurnRetry
    How a failed turn is retried (CIB7-2149).
    AgenticTurnRunner
    Runs one step of a turn: asks the agent what to do next and acts on what it did.
    AgenticTurnScheduler
    Schedules the next step of an agentic scope, unless one is already waiting to run.
    AgenticTurnTrigger
    Records what a child of an agentic scope produced as it ends, and gives the scope a further turn when one of its children has ended or has been removed.
